channel.title: Satipanya — Noirin's Essays
channel.description: Written essays and reflections by Noirin Sheahan, co-founder of Satipanya Buddhist Retreat. Short essays on practice, post-surgery reflections, and a series on climate change ethics from a Buddhist perspective.
